title: Intermediate publication_overrides.yml (contract v1)
description: Per-publication display overrides, keyed by BibTeX cite-key. These become BibTeX fields merged into the generated _bibliography/papers.bib — not a sidecar file (P3/D24). An override whose cite-key is absent from _incoming/papers.src.bib is a loud transform error, since it is almost always a typo or a stale entry.

propertyNames.description: BibTeX cite-key as it appears in the .bib.

selected.description: Feeds al-folio's `selected` BibTeX field, which drives the About page's selected-papers list.

abbr.description: Venue abbreviation badge. Can link out via _data/venues.yml.

preview.description: Filename under assets/img/publication_preview/. The asset itself is managed by hand in this repo (D22), and the transform fails loudly if the referenced file does not exist.
